nodes.characterization_summary: Pt thin-film electrodes decorated with various transition metals exhibit similar morphology characterized by islands of continuous Au nanoparticles, approximately 50-100 nm in particle size, with Pt or PtM nanoparticles densely wrapped around Au surfaces.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Exemplifying PtM-low, the atomic force microscopy (AFM) images show that the Pt thin-film electrodes decorated with various transition metals exhibit an overall similar morphology, which is characterized by islands of continuous Au nanoparticles, approximately 50 - 100 nm in particle size, with Pt or PtM nanoparticles densely wrapped around Au surfaces (Figure S3).

nodes.characterization_summary: CV of Pt thin-film electrode in 0.1 M KOH shows typical polycrystalline Pt surface features.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The cyclic voltammogram (CV) of the prepared Pt thin-film electrode in 0.1 M KOH (Figure 1b) shows the typical polycrystalline Pt surface features.

nodes.characterization_summary: SEIRAS spectra confirm continuous Pt thin-film with CO adsorption peaks at ~2078 cm⁻¹ (top sites) and 1875 cm⁻¹ (bridge sites), no Au interference at ~2100 cm⁻¹.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The SEIRAS spectra measured in CO-saturated 0.1 M HClO4 clearly exhibit two peaks at ~2078 and 1875 cm⁻¹ (Figure S2a), which are assigned to the C=O stretching modes of CO adsorbed on the top and bridge sites of the Pt surface, respectively, and no CO adsorption peak on Au that should be at ~2100 cm⁻¹ appears.

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ ATR-SEIRAS shows H-O-H bending vibration bands (δH-O-H) at ~1625 cm⁻¹ and O-H stretching vibration bands (νO-H) from 3000-3600 cm⁻¹ for interfacial water; δH-O-H frequency shows volcano relation with oxophilicity.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 3a-c shows the SEIRAS spectra of interfacial water molecules on the pristine and Ru-decorated Pt thin-film electrodes in 0.1 M KOH, which clearly display the H-O-H bending vibration bands (δH-O-H) located at ~1625 cm⁻¹ and the O-H stretching vibration bands (νO-H) from 3000 to 3600 cm⁻¹.

nodes.characterization_summary: No oxide reduction peak at ~1.15 V observed after oxidation at 1.5 V, confirming no Au substrate interference.
nodes.evidence_snippet: after the electrodes were oxidized at 1.5 V versus RHE for 5 s, there was no reduction peak of the oxide layer at ~1.15 V on the prepared Pt thin-film electrode surface when the potential was scanned from 1.5 to 0.9 V compared to the Au film electrode.
